entities.summary: Seppo Johannes Ahokainen was a Finnish professional ice hockey player. who played in the SM-liiga for Ilves and Tappara as well for the Finland national team. He was inducted into the Finnish Hockey Hall of Fame in 1993. Ahokainen died on 6 March 2024, at the age of 72.
